doc: Sets a record's status-effect fields (offsets 0x8-0xB) from a packed byte parameter `a1`, driven by a lookup flags-table `D_800714B0` indexed by `a1 & 0xFF`. If flags bit 0x10/0x20 set: field8=(a1&0xF)<<3, field9=(a1&0x70)>>1, fieldA=fieldB=8. Else if flag 0x40 set: field8=(a1&0xF)<<3, field9=(a1&0xF0)-0x60, fieldA=fieldB=8. Else if flag 0x80 set: writes a pre-packed 32-bit value from table D_80071410 directly over fields 8-11. Otherwise no fields are touched. Returns the same pointer passed in (a0).

globals.name: D_800714B0
globals.decl: extern u8 D_800714B0[]; /* plain byte flags-table, indexed 0-255 by a raw a1&0xFF byte; NOT a struct. Confirmed by sibling func_8004E69C.s which does the same lbu D_800714B0[byte] and tests bit 0x10. No struct fields — single byte per index, meaning is bitmask flags (bits seen used: 0x10,0x20,0x40,0x80).*/

globals.name: D_80071410
globals.decl: extern s32 D_80071410[]; /* word table, one s32 (pre-packed byte-quad) per same byte-index as D_800714B0, used only when flags&0x80 */
